sampledClaimReview.location: Incremental conversions / Understanding Incremental conversions and Attributed conversions; About Conversion Lift opening
sampledClaimReview.note: The linked official pages support the narrow attribution-versus-treatment/control comparison and account availability caveat. The draft does not transfer advertising effects to its offline AI pilot.

sampledClaimReview.location: Key messages; Workers will increasingly need to be able to use, analyse and interpret data
sampledClaimReview.note: The skill mix attribution is directly supported. The marketing role recommendations are explicitly the proposed managerial response, not a causal result from the brief.
Country scope and reported managerial perceptions match the source. The draft retains the perceptions distinction and does not extrapolate the survey to Dubai.

The capability domains and comparison of routine information work with contextual judgement match the abstract. The draft preserves the boundary between potential exposure and realised adoption/employment effects.

sampledClaimReview.location: Microsoft Table 1 G8/G9, PDF page 3; Google Return control to the user
sampledClaimReview.note: The narrow dismissal/correction and manual-handover context statements match the original sources. The surrounding approval workflow is a proposal, not a claim that oversight guarantees safety.

sampledClaimReview.location: INFORMS experimental setting and generalisability limitations; OECD report pages 58-60
sampledClaimReview.note: The study limitation is retained and no staffing forecast is inferred. The OECD pace/intensity paragraph accurately states the survey did not probe excessive workload.

sampledClaimReview.location: Leadership recommendation 9 and Scope and limits of this guide
sampledClaimReview.note: The attributed feedback recommendation and public-sector context match the official guide. The draft does not reuse the guide's adoption statistics or claim guaranteed trust.
